places.name: William Morris Gallery
places.description: A free gallery in the childhood home of designer and writer William Morris.

history.summary: E4 lies within Waltham Forest. Formed in 1965 from Chingford, Leyton, and Walthamstow. The William Morris Gallery in Walthamstow occupies the childhood home of the designer and writer William Morris; the borough was London's first Borough of Culture in 2019.
